2438-4336-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
2438-4336-5006-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-8174.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

3310-7176-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
3310-7176-7855.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing War Elemental to gain all creature types
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin, Orc and Army due to Oko, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-7175-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1086-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Anointer Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1086-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

215-1526-4460.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-4460.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6006-7297-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6006-7297-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6006-7297-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

924-3480-4149-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-3480-4149-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-3480-4149-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-3480-4149-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

5170-5256-6132-6772.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5195-7431-7634.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, targeting Practiced Scrollsmith.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Practiced Scrollsmith.
When Practiced Scrollsmith enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Daydream from exile by paying its mana cost, targeting Practiced Scrollsmith.
Repeat from step 2.

1575-5903-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

903-2199-6036.notablePrerequisites: Karplusan Minotaur has indestructible, protection from red or protection from creatures.
903-2199-6036.description:
Activate The Book of Exalted Deeds by paying {W}{W}{W}, tapping and exiling it.
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Resolve a Frenetic Efreet ability, causing you to flip a coin.
Karplusan Minotaur triggers. If you won the flip, it deals 1 damage to any target you choose. If you lost the flip, it deals 1 damage to a target of an opponent's choosing. You cannot lose the game due to this damage due to The Book of Exalted Deeds, and Karplusan Minotaur cannot be destroyed due to its indestructibility or protection.
Repeat from step 3.

147-997-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

129-3755-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3755-5137.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

2034-2308-6634.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-6634.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2534-3817-5686-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

uses.n: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

2468-6070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Doctors.
2468-6070.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Twice Upon a Time without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Twice Upon a Time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

856-997-2267-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-997-2267-4321.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1236-2018-2829.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
When Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Rattleblaze Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Rattleblaze Scarecrow is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

650-710-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding {C}{C}.
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

372-2493-3603.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Archaeomancer exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
372-2493-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4050-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, adding {1}.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

343-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
343-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
You are the monarch.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
343-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

301-2438-5643.notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-2438-5643.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

891-2034-2386-5220.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2034-2386-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant, adding {C}{C}.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

2231-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

942-1082-2757.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Samwise the Stouthearted by paying {1}{W}.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters the battlefield, it and Dual Nature's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Samwise the Stouthearted trigger, returning nothing to your hand from your graveyard, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Samwise, untapping the Plains.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted.
Put the nontoken Samwise the Stouthearted into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers as well as the Samwise the Stouthearted token's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Samwise the Stouthearted trigger, returning the nontoken Samwise the Stouthearted to your hand from your graveyard, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Holding priority, activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Samwise token, untapping the Plains.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, exiling the Samwise the Stouthearted token.
Repeat.

1636-4694-5309.notablePrerequisites: Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4694-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 artifact creature, and therefore dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
